privacy_intro_body: At Maghsalati we're committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains what we collect, how we use it, and how we keep it safe.
privacy_data_body: We collect your name, phone number, email address and pickup location, along with your order details. This data is needed to process and deliver your order.
privacy_usage_body: We use your data to process orders, determine pickup and delivery locations, send order status notifications, and improve the quality of our service.
privacy_sharing_body: We never sell your data. We only share the information needed with the laundry and the delivery courier to complete your order, such as your address and phone number.
privacy_security_body: We use an encrypted connection to protect your data in transit, and apply security measures to limit unauthorized access to your account.
privacy_rights_body: You can update your details at any time from the Edit Profile screen, and you may request deletion of your account and data by contacting us.
contact_header_body: If you have any question or an issue with your order, reach out through whichever channel suits you and we'll get back to you shortly.

support_intro_body: Our support team is available any time. Pick whichever way suits you best.
terms_s1_body: By using the Lavanderia partner app you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions. If you do not agree with any part of them, please do not use the app.
terms_s2_body: The laundry commits to providing the services listed on its account at the advertised quality and prices, keeping to its stated working hours, responding to incoming orders promptly, and safeguarding customer property.
terms_s3_body: The laundry sets its own service prices. A platform commission is deducted from the value of each completed order at the agreed rate, and payouts are transferred on the published schedule.
terms_s4_body: The laundry may reject an order before collecting the clothes, giving a reason. Repeated rejections without justification may lead to temporary suspension of the account or a lower ranking in search results.
terms_s5_body: The platform may suspend or close a laundry account if these terms are breached or customer complaints recur. The laundry may also end its subscription at any time once outstanding orders are fulfilled.
privacy_s1_body: We collect the details you enter at registration — laundry name, owner name, phone number, email address and location — along with data about the orders and services you provide.
privacy_s2_body: We use your data to show your laundry to nearby customers, route orders to you, calculate your payouts, improve service quality, and contact you about your account.
privacy_s3_body: We do not sell your data to anyone. We share only what is needed to complete an order, such as your laundry's name, address and contact number with the customer who placed it.
privacy_s4_body: We apply technical and organisational safeguards to secure your data, and it travels over an encrypted connection. Even so, no system on the internet can guarantee absolute security.
privacy_s5_body: You can view and change your data at any time from the profile page, and you can request deletion of your account and data by contacting the support team.
faq_q1: How do I receive new orders?
faq_a1: New orders arrive as an app notification and appear under the "New" tab on the orders page. Make sure "Available for work" is switched on from the home page so orders reach you.
faq_a2: Payouts are transferred on a regular schedule to your registered bank account after the platform commission is deducted. You can review every completed order from the orders page.
faq_q3: How do I change my service prices?
faq_a3: On the services page, tap the edit icon next to a service to change its price, or use the switch to pause it, then tap Save changes.
faq_q4: What if I am running late on a delivery?
faq_a4: Keep the order status up to date from the order details page so the customer stays informed. If the delay is significant, contact the support team so we can coordinate with the customer.
